policy: Only redistributable games with verified upstream source files and licence notices. System firmware remains user-supplied.

entries.title: Snake for Commodore 64
entries.description: Classic Snake in Commodore BASIC. Z and / steer; cursor keys and joystick also supported.
entries.controls: Z / or cursor keys to turn; RETURN pauses.
entries.author: David R. Van Wagner

entries.title: 8 Bit Island
entries.description: A Commodore BASIC text adventure featuring 20 locations, objects and multiple endings.
entries.controls: Type adventure commands using the C64 keyboard.
entries.author: gpowerf

entries.title: Meteor Storm
entries.description: Original C64 arcade action with meteors, sprites, music and wave-based scoring.
entries.controls: Consult the game menu for controls; joystick port can be swapped.
entries.author: C64AIToolChain project
